name: Extra Spell-Like Ability (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to use at least one spell-like ability

Benefit(s): Choose one of your spell-like abilities that emulates a spell of 3rd level or lower. If the emulated spell is 0- or 1st-level, you gain three additional uses of it per day; if it is 2nd-level, you gain two additional uses per day; and if it is 3rd-level, you gain one extra use per day. Caster level and all other factors remain the same.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time you select it, you may apply it to the same spell-like ability or to another spell-like ability.
